about.title: About Me
about.p1: With 6+ years of experience as a full-stack developer with a frontend focus, I build scalable production applications across frontend and backend systems, specializing in React, TypeScript, frontend architecture and performance.
about.p2: My work also spans testing, observability and reliable delivery, with experience in technical ownership, mentoring developers and improving engineering practices.

projects.title: Side Projects
projects.subtitle: Independent products I designed, built and still maintain — each shown at the maturity it has actually reached.
projects.showcaseDescription: Four products at four different stages. The badge on each card is the real state of the build, not a launch label.

magnetmiles.summary: Travel memories collected as visual fridge magnets, maps, passport stamps and shareable recaps.
magnetmiles.readinessNote: Local-first on device, with optional Google sync

coefpulse.summary: Shows how each European result moves a country's UEFA coefficient and its place in the ranking race.
coefpulse.readinessNote: Deterministic calculator on verified static data — not live scores

subtrackerrr.summary: Recurring-spend workspace built around one question: what renews next, and what is worth cancelling.
subtrackerrr.readinessNote: Private beta · guest workspace available without an account or bank connection

fitvalue.summary: Turns gym attendance and membership cost into a straight answer: keep it, downgrade it, or cancel it.
fitvalue.readinessNote: Live production build · correctness hardening ongoing

outthere.summary: Decision-first planner for a same-day trip that still gets you home by the time you set.
outthere.readinessNote: Pre-beta · Munich only, built-in trip data, no live routing
